mapper.sql: s.id AS id, s.workspace_id AS workspaceId, s.owner_id AS ownerId, s.filename AS filename, s.title AS title, s.expected_size AS expectedSize, s.expected_hash AS expectedHash, s.chunk_size AS chunkSize, s.chunk_count AS chunkCount, s.state AS state, s.media_id AS mediaId, s.expires_at AS expiresAt, s.finalize_epoch AS finalizeEpoch, s.lease_until AS leaseUntil, s.next_finalize_at AS nextFinalizeAt, s.quota_reserved AS quotaReserved, s.error_code AS errorCode, s.trace_id AS traceId, s.created_at AS createdAt
c.chunk_index AS `index`, c.hash AS hash, c.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, c.storage_key AS storageKey
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO upload_session (id, workspace_id, owner_id, filename, title, expected_size, expected_hash, chunk_size, chunk_count, state, media_id, expires_at, finalize_epoch, lease_until, next_finalize_at, quota_reserved, error_code, trace_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{s.id}, #{s.workspaceId}, #{s.ownerId}, #{s.filename}, #{s.title}, #{s.expectedSize}, #{s.expectedHash}, #{s.chunkSize}, #{s.chunkCount}, #{s.state}, #{s.mediaId}, #{s.expiresAt}, 0, NULL, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{s.quotaReserved}, #{s.errorCode}, #{s.traceId}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM upload_session s WHERE s.id = #{uploadId}
SELECT FROM upload_session s WHERE s.id = #{uploadId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO upload_chunk (upload_id, chunk_index, hash, size_bytes, storage_key, created_at) VALUES (#{uploadId}, #{c.index}, #{c.hash}, #{c.sizeBytes}, #{c.storageKey}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM upload_chunk c WHERE c.upload_id = #{uploadId} AND c.chunk_index = #{chunkIndex}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upload_chunk WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId}
mapper.update: UPDATE upload_session SET state = 'FINALIZING', error_code = NULL, next_finalize_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{uploadId} AND state = 'OPEN'

UPDATE upload_session SET finalize_epoch = finalize_epoch + 1, lease_until = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{uploadId} AND state = 'FINALIZING' AND next_finalize_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: SELECT finalize_epoch FROM upload_session WHERE id = #{uploadId}
mapper.update: UPDATE upload_session SET lease_until = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{uploadId} AND finalize_epoch = #{epoch} AND state = 'FINALIZING' AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE upload_session SET lease_until = NULL, next_finalize_at = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{nextAttemptMillis} MICROSECOND), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{uploadId} AND finalize_epoch = #{epoch} AND state = 'FINALIZING'

UPDATE upload_session SET state = 'COMPLETED', media_id = #{mediaId}, quota_reserved = 0, lease_until = NULL, error_code = NULL, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{uploadId} AND state = 'FINALIZING' AND finalize_epoch = #{epoch} AND media_id IS NULL
UPDATE upload_session SET state = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, lease_until = NULL, quota_reserved = 0, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{uploadId} AND state = 'FINALIZING'
UPDATE upload_session SET state = #{target}, lease_until = NULL, quota_reserved = 0, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{uploadId} AND state IN ('OPEN', 'FAILED')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM upload_session s WHERE s.state = 'OPEN' AND s.expires_at < UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY s.expires_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM upload_session s WHERE s.state = 'FINALIZING' AND s.next_finalize_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (s.lease_until IS NULL OR s.lease_until < UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY s.next_finalize_at ASC, s.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM upload_session s WHERE s.state = 'FINALIZING' AND s.lease_until IS NOT NULL AND s.lease_until < UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY s.lease_until ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM upload_session s WHERE s.state IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'EXPIRED', 'ABORTED') AND s.updated_at < DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{lookbackSeconds} SECOND) LIMIT #{limit}
